record.paper_title: Quo Vadis Strangeness? Strangeness — Open Questions
record.context_brief: QCD vacuum and finite-density phase transition
record.original_question: What are the structure of the QCD vacuum and the properties of the confinement-deconfinement phase transition at finite baryon density?

evidence.quote: Continue progressing towards an understanding of QCD-vacuum structure and properties of the phase transition at finite baryon density.

artifact.category_tag: QCD phase transitions at finite density
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Within the framework of Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD), the SU(3) non-abelian gauge theory of quarks and gluons, determine:

(a) the non-perturbative structure of the QCD vacuum (including condensates such as the quark condensate ⟨q̄q⟩ and the gluon condensate ⟨G_{μν}^a G^{μν,a}⟩, as well as topological structure) as a function of baryon chemical potential μ_B at zero or low temperature; and

(b) the order, location, and thermodynamic properties (e.g., critical exponents, latent heat, surface tension, and order parameters distinguishing color confinement from deconfinement) of the confinement–deconfinement phase transition of QCD matter at finite baryon density, as a function of (T, μ_B).

Provide a quantitative description of how the vacuum structure rearranges across this transition and characterize the boundary in the (T, μ_B) plane separating the confined (hadronic) phase from the deconfined (quark–gluon) phase.
artifact.status_search_result: The structure of the QCD vacuum and the nature of the confinement–deconfinement transition at finite baryon density remain open problems. Lattice QCD at finite μ_B suffers from the sign problem, and the existence and location of a conjectured QCD critical endpoint is still under active investigation by experiments (RHIC Beam Energy Scan, NA61/SHINE) and theory.

status_evidence.title: The QCD phase diagram from analytic continuation
status_evidence.snippet: The QCD phase diagram at finite baryon density remains a major open question due to the sign problem in lattice simulations.
status_evidence.claim: Finite-density QCD phase structure is still an open research problem.

status_evidence.title: RHIC Beam Energy Scan results
status_evidence.snippet: Experiments continue to search for the QCD critical point and characterize the phase transition at finite baryon density.
status_evidence.claim: Experimental searches for the finite-density QCD transition are ongoing.
